visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian boy, approximately five years old, sits at a wooden restaurant table wearing a dark grey sweater and a white bib with small illustrations. Before him is a black cast-iron pot and a glass bowl filled with diverse mushrooms, leafy greens, and enoki. The background features a large window showcasing an illuminated urban skyline at night with several prominent corporate signs like 'FUKURAS' visible. (2) The camera angle shifts downwards in a handheld motion to reveal a cracked raw egg resting on a grey carpeted floor near the table leg. The scene quickly cuts back to the boy, who displays a shy, squinted-eye expression while resting his chin on his hand. A large platter of raw, thinly sliced marbled beef is positioned in the immediate foreground on a black inductive stove. (3) An older male character with shoulder-length dark hair and glasses, dressed in a red and blue patterned cardigan, sits adjacent to the boy. He holds a spoon over a small glass bowl containing three scoops of white, pink, and green ice cream. The boy raises his hand in the air and gestures towards the bowl while talking with high facial animation and wide smiles. (4) The boy performs a 'wishing' gesture, pressing his palms together and closing his eyes tightly while seated. He then opens his mouth wide as the man feeds him a scoop of pink ice cream. Floating heart and sparkle emojis are digitally overlaid on the screen, and the scene concludes with both characters laughing and making eye contact in the warm indoor lighting.
